summary: Enhance your expertise in consumer psychology with our Data Analytics course. Discover how to leverage data for actionable insights into consumer behavior.
lede: Behavioral analytics applies psychological frameworks to data to interpret consumer decisions and identify friction in digital journeys. Marketing data analysts, UX researchers, product managers and customer experience leads can use it to segment behavior, track journey measures and plan experiments. The course covers RFM analysis, Python-based data cleaning, A/B test design, cognitive nudges, dashboard reporting and identifying bias in consumer models.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who operate at the intersection of data, design, and strategy, requiring a deeper understanding of the 'why' behind consumer actions.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of marketing principles and experience working with data in Excel. Familiarity with web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) is recommended. No prior coding experience is required, though a willingness to engage with basic Python® scripts is essential.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
